F01.title: Single-entry status is not printed on any sheet read
F01.detail: The 19 structure sheets read contain no re-entry, rebuy, or add-on wording, but none states single entry. Main-list rows say 'no re-entry/add-on wording on sheet'. Confirm in writing with the Venetian poker room.

F02.title: Event numbers are reused across flights, restarts and Day 2 rows
F02.detail: The official table repeats event numbers (for example 1, 7, 19, 26, 47, 56, 59). Multi-row events are grouped under one number and excluded.

F03.title: Event 6 prints no guarantee
F03.detail: Event 6 ($200 NLH, 1Day) has no GTD on the table or sheet 29. It is listed but not ranked.

F04.title: RaceDay events 3, 4, 5 have an unclear format and no guarantee
F04.detail: Title reads 'race to finish before the Race'. Sheet 18 prints no guarantee. Kept out of the main list and schedule.

F05.title: 50+ eligibility on events 24, 32 and 49
F05.detail: The schedule states 'must be 50+ years of age to participate'. These rows are eligibility-restricted, not general.

F06.title: Bounty events may carry a 'rake discount'
F06.detail: The schedule says PokerAtlas PRO members get a $20 rake discount. The sheet notes differ on the mechanism, so the discount is not applied to any ratio.

F07.title: Early-entry rake discounts on events 56 and 59
F07.detail: Printed as '$40 rake discount for entries before 10:10 a.m.' and '$20 rake discount before 11:10 a.m.'. These are flight events and are excluded.

F08.title: Structure sheet links differ by row
F08.detail: The same event number links to different sheets on different dates (for example 1A and 1B). Each row's own link is used.

F09.title: Late-registration cutoffs are printed for only two sheets
F09.detail: Only sheets 1 and 8 print a 9:40 PM late-registration cutoff. Other rows are blank. No cutoff is computed from level lengths.

F10.title: Finish times and plausible durations are not published
F10.detail: Overlap flags use a planning assumption of 6 hours between starts. This is not an official duration (see schedule page).

F11.title: No official tournament starts before 10:10 AM
F11.detail: The earliest start on the Venetian table is 10:10 AM (events 32, 24, 3, 4, 5, 39, 47, 49, 56). The 8:00 AM all-day plan cannot be built from verified data.

F12.title: Venetian calendar and the Nov 17-19 quote disagree
F12.detail: Calendar cell Nov 17 = $605 and Nov 18 = $165. Quote nights are $824.25 and $164.25. The quote is used for the true-cost calculation. The calendar is logged only.

F13.title: PokerAtlas PRO wording differs between schedule and sheet
F13.detail: Schedule: '$20 rake discount'. Sheet 8 (earlier read): '$20 off initial buy-in ($180)'. Membership cost is not verified. Standard buy-in is used.

F14.title: Standard buy-in used for the PokerAtlas PRO discount events
F14.detail: Events 18 and 58 are listed at $200. The discount is not applied.

F15.title: LIPS events add a fee on top of the buy-in
F15.detail: Sheet 33 prints a $80 fee and a $10 LIPS fee within the $600 buy-in ($510 pool). The $600 total is used as printed.

F16.title: Venetian poker-suite rates are conditional and not mapped to a property
F16.detail: 'Start as low as $119 and $209' requires 6 hours of live cash play or a $300+ buy-in each night. Not used in the true-cost calculation.

F17.title: Venetian calendar cells are not quotes
F17.detail: Cells show the lowest suite price per date, including the resort fee and excluding tax. Dec 10-12 show no price. Not used in any total.

F18.title: Cancellation deadline and walking time not captured for Venetian quote
F18.detail: No cancellation deadline on the captured quote page. No official walking time for any hotel. Both left blank.

F19.title: Bellagio Saturday buy-in conflict
F19.detail: Page button reads $1,000; PDF header reads $1,100 (from earlier read); rule body reads $600 buy-in with $510 pool, $50 house, $40 gratuity. Excluded as multi-flight.

F20.title: Bellagio Friday allows re-entry and sells extra chips
F20.detail: Re-entry through the end of level 8. A $40 voluntary gratuity buys chips. Excluded from the single-entry list.

F21.title: Bellagio Saturday is multi-flight
F21.detail: Flights 1A-1D and a combined Day 2; registration to level 10. Excluded.

F22.title: Bellagio Sunday H.O.R.S.E. structure not read
F22.detail: Excluded until the structure is read.

F23.title: Bellagio page carries a stale 'resume Saturday, July 26' notice
F23.detail: July 26, 2026 is a Sunday, and the notice is undated. Not treated as current.

F24.title: Wynn fee and cancellation terms come from an expired offer
F24.detail: Wynn terms page 850070 covers an offer that ended Sept 30, 2025. No current Wynn fee, rate, or cancellation rule is verified.

F25.title: Wynn WPT formats not reviewed beyond structures chunk 0
F25.detail: Most WPT rows are flights, satellites, or multi-day. None is listed as single-entry. Excluded from the main list.

F26.title: Wynn WPT schedule prints Dec 18 with two weekdays
F26.detail: Rows say Dec 18 is 'Wednesday' in one place and 'Friday' in another. Dec 18, 2026 is a Friday. Unresolved.

F27.title: WPT $1,100 PLO breakdown sums to $1,105
F27.detail: Earlier read of the structures PDF. Not used in any calculation.

F28.title: Wynn daily Friday is a rebuy, and daily suspension does not name WPT
F28.detail: Poster prints 'NLH REBUY $240' on Friday. The Wynn page says daily events are suspended during Signature, Millions and Classic series. WPT is not named, so it is unclear whether daily events run during WPT.

F29.title: ARIA prints no tournament schedule or room rates
F29.detail: The page offers 'exclusive room rates' by phone (702.590.7232) and email. No value is printed.

F30.title: Five Strip poker pages gave no verified schedule
F30.detail: Caesars page is general; MGM Grand page returned 'Page not found'; Golden Nugget page is blank; Resorts World page is an email template; Circa returns 404. These rooms are not listed.

F31.title: Third-party claim of a $55 Bellagio resort fee is not verified here
F31.detail: Coordination entries from other sessions say Bellagio terms confirm a $55 + tax fee. No Bellagio fee source was read in this session. Left blank.

F32.title: Monitor baseline not yet run
F32.detail: The sandbox cannot reach venue sites. The daily monitor needs its first run in CI (see monitor page).
